dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Runtime - PHP-FPM Pool Health
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for PHP-FPM worker capacity, listen queue pressure, max children, slow requests, process churn, and APM latency correlation. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: PHP-FPM pool health
pages.description: Runtime capacity and saturation signals for PHP-FPM.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.activeProcesses), latest(php_fpm.pool.idleProcesses), latest(php_fpm.pool.totalProcesses) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.listenQueue), latest(php_fpm.pool.maxListenQueue), latest(php_fpm.pool.listenQueueLength) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.maxChildrenReached) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.slowRequests) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.startSince), latest(php_fpm.pool.acceptedConnections) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(php_fpm.pool.activeProcesses), latest(php_fpm.pool.idleProcesses), latest(php_fpm.pool.listenQueue), latest(php_fpm.pool.maxChildrenReached) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET pool.name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Dashboard queries expect PHP-FPM pool metrics from a local or integration source. Keep any status endpoint private or local-only.
